title: Dungeon, Cave, Interior, Isometric, Deck-Plan, Section & Multi-Level Builder
objective: Implement the shared room/level/vertical-projection cartography kernel for dungeons, caves, interiors, isometric/staggered views, deck plans, sections/cutaways and multi-level maps while keeping runtime topology and 3D truth owner-controlled.

scope.purpose: Provide one shared room/level/vertical-projection cartography kernel for enclosed, subterranean, vehicle/deck and multi-level map classes without becoming runtime topology or canonical 3D authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative dungeon, cave, interior, deck-plan, section/cutaway and multi-level documents can deterministically author and inspect shared room/level/vertical-projection state while runtime topology and canonical 3D truth remain external owner authority.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MCS-14 publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order; MCS-15 is next selected.
MCS-14 delivered one deterministic room/level/vertical-projection kernel for dungeon, cave, interior, isometric, deck-plan, section/cutaway and multi-level cartography.

Walls/floors/rooms/passages, caves/tunnels, openings, stairs/ladders/elevators, roofs/overheads, object placement/templates, level management, blueprint/reference traces and GM layers remain cartographic presentation/projection state.
Cross-level relationships remained explicit noncanonical visual receipts; MCS-14 inferred no runtime topology and created no canonical 3D truth.
Generalized semantic binding and owner-version synchronization remained reserved to MCS-18; tactical LOS/collision/cover/movement/hazard adjudication remained outside MCS-14.
MCS-15, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work were not started by this execution.
next_action: MCS-14 is closed. MCS-15 is selected_not_started; wait for a later owner Continue before granting MCS-15 implementation authority.
